blurb: Guests can rent various yachts and sailing boats for private charters ranging from 2 hours to multi-day trips. Options include luxury motor yachts, sailing schooners, catamarans, and party yachts with amenities like captain and crew, fuel, and port fees included. Destinations include Marina del Rey, Catalina Island, Newport Beach, Long Beach, and Miami.
